wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on March 12, 2026 under Executive Order 13810, program tag DPRK4, for support to Yun Song Guk

details.label: Passport
details.value: XDB250498 (Spain); alt. EM0642806 (Dominican Republic), issued February 28, 2013, expired February 28, 2019

wanted_details.caution: Since at least 2023, DPRK national Yun Song Guk (Yun) led a group of North Korean IT workers that conduct freelance IT work operating out of Boten, Laos. Yun coordinated several dozen financial transactions totaling more than $70,000 with Hoang Minh Quang (Minh) relating to IT services performed by Yun. Since at least 2024, Yun also worked with York Louis Celestino Herrera (Celestino) to develop freelance IT service contracts for Yun.

sources.title: Recent Actions, March 12, 2026: North Korea Designations (Yun Song Guk, Amnokgang Technology Development Company and facilitators in Vietnam, Laos and Spain)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions Key Enablers of DPRK IT Worker Networks

disclaimer: York Louis Celestino Herrera is a Dominican and Spanish national, not a DPRK national, and is profiled here as the Barcelona-based facilitator the Treasury says developed freelance IT service contracts for Yun Song Guk's group since at least 2024.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
name_korean_not_applicable: Dominican and Spanish national and contract facilitator rather than a DPRK national, so no Korean rendering of the name applies.
